initial: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production 2D fighting-game animation atlas. The supplied image is a CHARACTER DESIGN REFERENCE ONLY: use ONLY the black smoke monster in its BOTTOM RIGHT quadrant. Do not draw any of the three human heroes. Preserve this exact Air Pollution Monster: enormous floating charcoal-black billowing smoke body, dense dark grey curls and wisps, blazing orange eyes beneath a furrowed smoke brow, cavernous black mouth with many sharp grey fangs, two long muscular smoke arms ending in clawed smoke hands. No legs, feet, clothes, armor, weapons, horns, green slime, human skin or new features. Detailed shaded comic style and the same fierce face as the reference. Every pose faces SCREEN LEFT in three-quarter combat view. Lower body tapers into a curling smoke tail. All poses use the same scale and proportions. ONE transparent PNG, exactly SIXTEEN separate complete figures in a 4-column by 4-row grid. Give every figure generous transparent gutters, at least 25px clear space inside each cell: every fingertip, smoke tendril and tail must be complete and isolated. No text, grid, floor, shadow, colored haze or backdrop; outside the monster is true alpha 0. Pose order, row-major: 0 neutral hovering guard; 1 subtle inhale with shoulders raised and smoke chest expanded; 2 exhale with shoulders lowering and smoke curls gathered; 3 glide left anticipation with torso inclining slightly left and tail flowing right. 4 glide left compressed mid-pulse; 5 glide left stretched smoke tail and reaching claw; 6 glide left settling into next pulse. 7 PUNCH PREPARATION near claw clenched as a smoke fist drawn up and back; 8 PUNCH RELEASE forceful downward/forward claw slam, torso leaning left, keep fist attached and complete; 9 recoil/recovery with claw drawing back into guard. 10 TOXIC CLOUD CHARGE inhale, chest swelling, claws cupped near the open mouth; 11 TOXIC CLOUD CAST exhale gesture with mouth open and both claws extended down-left, but no emitted projectile or detached cloud. 12 SMOG STORM CHARGE both claws lifted high above shoulders; 13 SMOG STORM PULSE both claws sweeping forcefully downward, furious roaring face. 14 LIGHT HIT RECOIL head/chest tipped slightly backward toward screen right; 15 HEAVY HIT RECOIL body and smoke tail curling backward right with claws flaring apart. Keep face identity consistent and visible in every frame. No duplicates or mirrored copies; full-body redrawn poses. Preferred size 2048x2048.
